text: Korea Listed Company Fundamentals and Valuation Data in English - DART Financial Statements, PER, PBR, ROE, Convertible Bonds (API, CSV, JSON)

Financial statements, valuation multiples and convertible bond filings for 2,709 Korean listed companies, built from DART regulatory filings and open government data and delivered in English through a REST API, CSV and JSON. Each dataset states its source and the date it was measured.

SeoulMarkets builds structured datasets from Korean public filings and publishes them in English. The primary sources (DART, the Financial Supervisory Service's disclosure system, and the Korea Public Data Portal) are public but written in Korean, with company names and account names that cannot be translated by rule. We normalise them into one English schema.

What is included

- Company valuation: PER, PBR, ROE and debt-to-equity for 2,709 listed Korean companies, with the price date and the financial-statement year behind each multiple.
- Company financials: annual financial statements as filed to DART (13,545 company-years), with English account names from a hand-mapped dictionary of K-IFRS accounts.
- Mezzanine filings: 5,084 convertible bond, bond-with-warrant and exchangeable bond filings at company level, with conversion terms, so potential dilution can be measured before it reaches the share count.
- Reference data: official English names for Korean listed companies, and an account dictionary for reading raw Korean statements.

The same schema is available for Japan (3,709 companies) and Taiwan (1,098 companies) as separate products.

How it is built

- Every figure is computed from the filing itself. We do not resell a vendor feed.
- Values that could not be measured are returned as null with the reason stated, not filled with zero. Example: PER is null when net income is not positive, and those rows are kept so the denominator stays visible.
- Each dataset states its measurement date. Valuation multiples are trailing annual multiples: market value on a stated trading day against the latest annual report.
- The product contains company-level data only. It contains no personal data.

Delivery

- REST API (JSON) with an OpenAPI description, CSV and JSON files, and an MCP server for AI assistants.
- A free tier and dated samples are available without a call.

Use cases

- Screening and valuation work on Korean equities without Korean-language processing.
- Measuring dilution risk from outstanding convertible bonds.
- Comparing Korea with Japan and Taiwan on the same fields.
- Feeding English-labelled Korean fundamentals into research tools and AI assistants.

Licence

Underlying data are public regulatory filings and open government data. We add structure, identifiers and English labels. The grant covers internal use and derived research; redistribution of the raw file is not granted.
